editionLabel: Hasbro English instructions, item 40198 (electronic Funatomy edition)
firstPlayerRule: The youngest "doctor" goes first. Play then passes to the left.
clarifications: This edition has two skill levels set by a switch on the board: Level 1 for younger players, and Level 2 (which buzzes immediately on touching the metal side of a cavity) for older or more experienced players.
The game ends when all 13 Funatomy parts have been collected; whoever collected the most wins.
